name: Coaster
description: A disc with two rings cut through it, both in the ink of the disc itself.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 47%, transparent 47%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0 20%, transparent 20% 27%, #000 27% 36%, transparent 36% 43%, #000 43%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 47%, transparent 47%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0 20%, transparent 20% 27%, #000 27% 36%, transparent 36% 43%, #000 43%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
